sections.title: What it is
sections.body: A shared action where one PC leads and the other PCs support with reaction rolls.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use when several PCs work on the same task together and one clear leader makes sense.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use when several PCs work on the same task together and one clear leader makes sense.
Choose a leader. Other PCs describe help and make reaction rolls; their successes and failures adjust the leader's action roll.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.
